speaker: Gary E. Stevenson
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Fruit to Make One Happy
summary: Elder Stevenson, speaking especially to Primary children, uses Lehi's vision of the tree whose fruit is desirable to make one happy to teach that gospel truths become sweet as we live them. He shares three gospel fruits he loves: we are children of a loving Heavenly Father, the great plan of happiness through Jesus Christ, and the gift of the Holy Ghost, told through a small boy singing "I Am a Child of God" after an earthquake and a grieving Buddhist priest in Japan comforted to learn where his wife was. He invites children to love, share, and invite so family and friends can taste the fruit too, and promises even greater joy as they do.
